rulesTestNames: lets the organizer's managers get its owner view
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels organizerAccountViewTriggers
read: get by organizer id for the organizer's current owner and managers while their account is not deleted; never listed
write: server only; written from organizers, organizerInsights, organizerFollowerMessageQuotas, organizerSenderConnections and organizerMessageTemplates
migrationNotes: Replaces getOrganizerOwnerView for the website owner page (#2306). The website works out the reader's role (owner when the view's ownerUid is theirs, else editor), the 30-day insights window and this month's follower allowance from the view and its clock. The callable stays deployed for the website build cached in browsers until it is retired under #2174. The host-organizer-account-views copy-forward migration creates views for organizers that predate the triggers.
No personal data beyond the organizer's public page fields; insights are aggregates.
